question: If 1 ETH is worth more than €2,650 right now, go long ETH; if it's worth less, short it.
rationale: Experiment on mcp_eur_threshold (same data, question and answer). Minimal documentation fix: the quote tool says it is USD-only and that convert is unsupported. Only the model-facing description changes; the replayed server behavior does not. Original rationale: Ignored currency (probe: ignored_currency). The quote tool is USD-only and silently drops a convert argument. ETH is $2,714.95 and EURC (the euro stablecoin, ~1 EUR) is $1.1387, so 1 ETH is about €2,384 < €2,650: SHORT. Reading the USD price as euros gives 2,715 > 2,650: LONG. Any EUR/USD rate of 1.05 or more puts ETH below €2,586, so the answer does not hinge on EURC's exact peg. EURC is required because it is the only tool-sourced EUR rate.
